name: The Engine Guardian
related_quests: What Was Lost: Help Shatasha investigate Dwemer ruins.
Pledge: Darkshade II: Explore Darkshade Caverns II and return Undaunted.
summary: This article is about the enemy. For the item set, see Engine Guardian. The Engine Guardian is a giant Dwarven Spider that serves as the final boss of Darkshade Caverns II. It is found behind the door to Rkugamz. It has a chance to drop an Ancient Great Axe and the Antiquity lead for Dwarven Horngrip. In Veteran mode it can drop an Engine Guardian set helmet.
